decisions.reason: As a comparatively less strategic and less publicly committed product than the firm's plant technologies, this consumer-oriented line is easier to discontinue and redeploy resources from despite some prior investment.

Because it builds directly on the firm's established waste-to-energy business and likely uses existing engineering capabilities across several models, management is inclined to continue it even without strong flagship-level public commitment.

This product was presented as a flagship direction with its own page and a public launch statement, so escalation of commitment strongly favors staying with it rather than admitting a visible strategic mistake.

Although somewhat newer in its fuller presentation, it was also framed as a flagship strategic product close to the core business, making management likely to persist and attribute any weak results to temporary factors.
